# Which Error Code

> Which Error Code (whicherrorcode.com) explains home appliance error codes and official refrigerator water filter numbers. Every code is cited to the manufacturer. Last verified 19 Nov 2026.

Independent. Not affiliated with any appliance maker. Unplug the appliance and shut off the gas before any inspection past the published checks.
